description: This Java class configures the OpenAPI documentation and CORS settings for a Spring Boot application. It sets up server URLs for Swagger UI, ensuring it communicates correctly across different environments, and configures CORS to allow cross-origin requests during development.

classes.name: OpenApiConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for setting up OpenAPI documentation and CORS policies in a Spring Boot application.

methods.name: customOpenAPI
methods.description: Creates and returns an OpenAPI object configured with API info and server URLs, including relative path and explicit preview URL.

methods.name: corsConfigurer
methods.description: Returns a WebMvcConfigurer that sets up CORS to allow all origins, methods, headers, and exposed headers for development testing.
